'''Enchant Crossbow Bolts (Emerald)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 27 to cast. It imbues 10 [[emerald bolts]] each cast and turns them into [[emerald bolts (e)]] or 10 [[emerald dragon bolts]] into 10 [[emerald dragon bolts (e)]]. The enchantment gives the effect ''magical poison.'' Each bolt has a high chance of [[poison]]ing your target for 5 damage initially. This is an alternative way of poisoning your enemies if you don't have a poisoning weapon in your inventory. It's also a great way to poison them from a distance. It is sometimes used in [[PvP]] to poison another player before switching to a different weapon or better bolts.
